analogy.rationale: Norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors block SLC6A2 (and often SLC6A3/SLC6A4), but these cell lines are non-neuronal and express monoamine transporters at negligible levels, so transcriptional responses should be weak; the closest analogs are other monoamine transporter/reuptake inhibitors that share the same targets and lack of effect in these cells.
